paper_title: Search for light scalar Dark Matter candidate with AURIGA detector
notes: AURIGA resonant-mass detector search for scalar moduli DM. The paper constrains both d_e (electromagnetic gauge modulus, ScalarPhoton) and d_me (electron mass modulus, ScalarElectron) with the same limit curve (di = dme = de). Limit d_i <~ 1e-5 in the sensitive band f=850-950 Hz, corresponding to m_phi ~ 3.6e-12 eV (900 Hz). Only one numerical point extractable from text/abstract; the full curve is in Fig. 5 which is not numerically tabulated. Coupling type ambiguous between ScalarPhoton (d_e) and ScalarElectron (d_me) since the limit applies equally to both. | Vision: Auriga limit curve labeled d_i; the hint suggests d_e (ScalarPhoton) but the plot shows multiple couplings (d_me and d_e). The Auriga curve is plotted for the electron-mass coupling d_me context. The curve spans ~850-960 Hz corresponding to ~3.55e-12 to 4.0e-12 eV. Y-axis is dimensionless coupling d_i. Coupling type ambiguous between ScalarElectron (d_me) and ScalarPhoton (d_e). | Calibration: No calibration needed
